title: ALMA 690 GHz Observations of IRAS 16293-2422B: Infall in a Highly Optically Thick Disk
question: What are the continuum structure, line morphology and infall kinematics of IRAS 16293-2422B at 690 GHz, and is its dust optically thick?

data.sensitivity: line rms ~50 mJy/beam per 0.4 km/s; continuum rms 20 mJy/beam

what.value: Dust mass opacity extrapolated to 0.45 mm for coagulated grains without ice mantles (2.2 cm2/g)

evidence.quote: obtained extrapolating at these wavelenghts the value obtained by (cite: Oss1994) for coagulated dust particles with no ice mantles
Assuming also an opacity power-law index $\beta$ = 0.6 (cite: Rod2005)

what.value: Pineda et al. two-layer fit results at 220 GHz (Tx = 40 K) used to set Tx

evidence.quote: From the fits of Pineda et al. (2012) to lines at lower frequencies (220 GHz) they estimate $T_x$ = 40 K.

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image continuum and lines
recipe.method: CASA calibration and CLEAN imaging, robust 0.5

recipe.goal: Brightness temperature and lower-limit dust mass
recipe.method: Planck-equation Tb from flux and Gaussian beam; optically thin isothermal dust mass
assumptions: kappa = 2.2 cm2/g, beta = 0.6, Td = 160 K, d = 120 pc

recipe.goal: Moment maps and velocity gradient / dynamical mass
recipe.method: Moment 0 and 1 maps; Keplerian mass from east-west gradient, corrected by sin(i) with i=5 deg

recipe.goal: Fit inverse P-Cygni profiles with two-layer infall model
recipe.method: Modified two-layer model with fixed Tc=160 K, Phi=0.37, Tx=50 K, Tf=3 K; fit Vin, sigma_v, tau0, VLSR
assumptions: Tx decreases as sqrt of distance; Pineda gas 50% more distant

evidence.quote: The dust compact source has a deconvolved size of about 400 $\pm$ 55 *milli-arcseconds* or a spatial size of 50 AU
The flux density of IRAS 16293$-$2422B at these wavelengths is 12.5 $\pm$ 0.5 Jy and has a peak flux of 3.2 $\pm$ 0.2 Jy Beam$^{-1}$.
has a peak flux of 3.2 $\pm$ 0.2 Jy Beam$^{-1}$
we estimated a brigthness temperature at these wavelengths for IRAS16293$-$2422B of 160 K
we estimated a lower limit for the mass for the disk of about 0.03 M$_\odot$
The molecular ring like structure has a diameter of 850 $\pm$ 50 *milli-arcseconds* and an inner diameter of 300 $\pm$ 50 *milli-arcseconds*
a clear east-west velocity gradient of approximately 1.3 km s$^{-1}$ over 60 AU

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version and calibration procedure (SV calibrated data vs. own reduction)
Gain, bandpass calibrator assignment per execution and flux scale uncertainty
Line-free channels and continuum subtraction method
Cell size, image size, clean threshold, masks
Grid ranges and fit statistic for the two-layer model
Continuum position/coordinates and deconvolution method for size
score_reason: Public SV data and simple analysis, but many processing details and model grid specifics missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public SV data; numeric results (size, flux, Tb, model parameters) are checkable, though recipe is incomplete.
